_note: 20 evaluation personas for the Taste Lift parameter sweep (scripts/param_sweep.py). One movie, one artist and one videogame each, mixing Indian and global tastes. Seeds come from a shared pool of 24 well-known titles so the sweep stays within ~25 Qloo calls (15 of them reuse Day-1 search fixtures); no two personas share more than one seed. Motorsport-themed seeds are deliberately avoided so they don't trivially boost F1 drivers.
